MicrosoftGraphUserProfile.Description: Write configured profile-card fields back to Microsoft Entra ID. Photo updates are enabled separately.
MicrosoftGraphUserProfile.ConsentInformation: Read and update users allows editing profile fields on behalf of the signed-in user. It does not grant permission to create or delete user accounts.
MicrosoftGraphUserProfile.Title: Update Entra ID profile fields from profile card

MicrosoftGraphUserPhoto.Description: Write profile photo changes made in Omnia back to Microsoft Entra ID, including removal of a profile photo.
MicrosoftGraphUserPhoto.ConsentInformation: Read and write all user and group profile photos allows Omnia to update user photos on behalf of the signed-in user. Updating another user's photo also requires an appropriate Entra administrator role.
MicrosoftGraphUserPhoto.Title: Update Entra ID profile photos
